Ready to cheer on the Grizzlies during Homecoming Week? 🐻📣 GGC students, faculty and staff can enjoy free admission all year long with GGC Athletics’ new All-Sports Pass! 

Your Claw Card will no longer get you into games, so claim your free pass today by following these steps:

1. Go to the link in our bio. 
2. Select “Season Passes” on the webpage.
3. Scroll to the bottom of the page and select “Have a passcode?”

5. Redeem your pass and add your ticket to your phone’s wallet for easy access on game day.
6. Enjoy GGC Athletics all year long!
